# Table.AggregateTableColumn

```m
Table.AggregateTableColumn(table as table, column as text, aggregations as list) as table
```

Aggregates a column of tables into multiple columns in the containing table.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/table-aggregatetablecolumn)
